lines.vo: It's three A.M. You're asleep. And something on the internet is working for you.
lines.cap: 3 AM. You're ASLEEP. Something is WORKING for you.

lines.vo: Nobody asked it anything. No prompt. It just... started.
lines.cap: NO PROMPT. It just... STARTED.

lines.vo: This is always-on AI. Stay till the end, because there's one thing it is never allowed to do.
lines.cap: ALWAYS-ON AI. And ONE THING it can NEVER do.

lines.vo: Meet Sara. She runs a small online shop.
lines.cap: Meet SARA. She runs a small SHOP.

lines.vo: Before bed, she gave her agent one goal. Never run out of stock. Then she closed her laptop.
lines.cap: One GOAL: never run out of STOCK.

lines.vo: But her agent doesn't live on her laptop. It runs in the cloud, on its own computer. So it keeps going.
lines.cap: It runs in the CLOUD, on its OWN COMPUTER.

lines.vo: Every always-on agent runs the same loop. A trigger. It thinks. It acts. It checks in.
lines.cap: TRIGGER. THINK. ACT. CHECK IN.

lines.vo: Then it goes back to watching.
lines.cap: Then back to WATCHING.

lines.vo: At three oh seven, a trigger fires.
lines.cap: 3:07. A TRIGGER fires.

lines.vo: Sara's best seller drops to five left. The agent finds her supplier, fills the cart, heads to checkout...
lines.cap: Stock drops to 5. It FILLS THE CART...

lines.vo: and stops.
lines.cap: ...and STOPS.

lines.vo: Why did it stop? Pause and guess. A, it crashed. B, it needs Sara's yes. C, it ran out of time.
lines.cap: Why did it STOP? PAUSE and guess.

lines.vo: B. Spending money is a big action, and big actions wait for a human.
lines.cap: B! Big actions WAIT FOR A HUMAN.

lines.vo: Seven A.M. Sara wakes up to her morning brief. One order, waiting for approval.
lines.cap: 7 AM. Her MORNING BRIEF.

lines.vo: One tap. It pays with a one-time card that works only for that purchase.
lines.cap: One TAP. A ONE-TIME CARD.

lines.vo: This isn't science fiction.
lines.cap: This isn't SCIENCE FICTION.

lines.vo: In September, OpenAI launched dots. Always-on agents in ChatGPT that work on your goals in the background.
lines.cap: Sept: OpenAI launched DOTS.

lines.vo: In October, Anthropic previewed Claude Duet. It sends a morning brief, and runs on its own cloud computer.
lines.cap: Oct: Anthropic previewed CLAUDE DUET.

lines.vo: And that one thing it's never allowed to do? Duet keeps moving money blocked, even if you say yes.
lines.cap: MOVING MONEY stays BLOCKED. Even if you say yes.

lines.vo: Paying, signing, deleting? It asks first.
lines.cap: PAYING. SIGNING. DELETING. It ASKS FIRST.

lines.vo: It can still misjudge what's urgent, or get fooled by a sneaky email. So you stay the boss.
lines.cap: It can still be FOOLED. You stay THE BOSS.

lines.vo: Would you let an AI work your night shift? Tell me below.
lines.cap: Would YOU let AI work your NIGHT SHIFT?

lines.vo: Next up: how to get your business recommended by AI search.
lines.cap: Next: get recommended by AI SEARCH.
